about.title: About
about.paragraph1: I'm a <highlight>Full Stack</highlight> developer with experience building software for large logistics companies, and I currently work at <highlight>Leapfone</highlight>, a smartphone rental startup, focused on building scalable applications.
about.paragraph2: I have experience developing frontend and backend applications using <highlight>React</highlight>, <highlight>TypeScript</highlight>, <highlight>Angular</highlight>, <highlight>Node.js</highlight>, <highlight>Express</highlight>, <highlight>NestJS</highlight>, <highlight>GraphQL</highlight>, <highlight>.NET</highlight>, and <highlight>PostgreSQL</highlight>, as well as libraries like <highlight>MUI Joy UI</highlight> and monitoring/observability tools like <highlight>Sentry</highlight>.
about.paragraph3: I hold a degree in Systems Analysis and Development, and I aim to apply solid architecture practices, clean code, and software engineering fundamentals to deliver robust, efficient, high-quality solutions.

guep-frontend.description: Built interfaces with Angular and TypeScript, focused on reusable components, API integration, and usability for large-scale systems.

guep-backend.description: Developed and maintained systems such as Score (driver registration), Kavuka (driver history), Backoffice, and Processo Limpo, using Node, Express, Sequelize, and Redis.

leapfone.description: Frontend with React, TypeScript, and MUI Joy UI integrated via GraphQL; backend in .NET and PostgreSQL with REST and gRPC APIs, applying DDD and Clean Code. Containerization with Docker and observability with Sentry.
